chunks: And those who, when wronged, defend themselves.

key_terms.الْبَغْيُ: Oppression or injustice done by an aggressor
key_terms.يَنْتَصِرُونَ: They defend themselves or seek retribution

ai.seo_question: How do believers respond to injustice according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as granting believers the right to self-defense (intiqam) when aggrieved, balancing the virtue of patience (sabr) with active justice. Scholars like Allamah Tabatabai emphasize that this 'defense' is not mere retaliation but a measured response to restore equity, distinguishing the faithful from those who are either overly passive or aggressively vengeful. This principle underpins the Shia concept of maintaining dignity and rights within the community.
